notes: Paper match: arXiv 1608.01329 = Golovich et al. 2016 ApJ 831, 110 (DOI 10.3847/0004-637X/831/1/110). This is a dynamical (galaxy/spectroscopy) paper: it contains NO weak-lensing map or lensing-peak coordinates and NO X-ray peak coordinates. The only I-G information is a single sentence citing Smith et al. 2009 (strong lensing): X-ray peak offset 15 arcsec NW of the lensing mass peak (no uncertainty). There is no stated I-S offset or G-S offset value. Pointer mismatch: in the arXiv source Table 2 is 'Subcluster membership and BIC scores' (no positions); positions are in §3.2 text and Table 3; §4 'Merger scenario' has no subsection 4.2 in the arXiv version (published numbering may differ); Fig. 8 = reproduction of Ogrean et al. 2016 Chandra map with white plusses at subcluster locations (no numbers). RA uncertainties are printed in seconds of time (1 s of RA = 13.87 arcsec at Dec +22.4 deg); the Table 3 RA error (±4.5 s ≈ 62 arcsec) vs Dec error (±6.0 arcsec) asymmetry is large and might indicate a unit typo (arcsec printed as s) - flag, do not resolve. Separation (my computation, not a paper value) between the NW luminosity peak and the GMM subcluster-1 centre is ~21.7 arcsec. Under the protocol (luminosity-weighted centroid tabulated? no; BCG coordinates given? no) this paper gives no numeric BCG position; x_I and x_G are not given as positions either. Classification is left to the analyst.
